title: Test vehicle passenger's side rear engine compartment magnetic field reading
description: Overexposed color photo of a hand holding an EM meter near the reflective side of a vehicle, with the meter face at bottom. Caption: "TEST VEHICLE - Passenger's side rear engine compartment magnetic field reading." Notes below report the witness feeling the car drives faster and describe an investigator's Nikon D700 camera batteries failing during the investigation, with names redacted (AAP Person 103).
